communication.quote: I listened to the whole thing first, then went through the charges with them line by line and explained what had changed.

problem_solving.quote: I flagged it to my team lead right away and stayed on the line while a billing specialist got involved, so the customer wasn't passed around.

tips: Replace "I honestly don't remember the exact amount" with a clearly labelled best estimate (for example, "about three charges, roughly 40 EUR total"), so the answer shows the outcome, not just the uncertainty.
In T3b, close the loop: name the root cause the billing specialist found, state how the charge was reversed, and say how you followed up with the customer afterwards.
